table_location.table_caption: Suzuki–Miyaura cross-coupling of 4-bromoanisole with phenylboronic acid in methanol-induced by Pd-bpydc-Ln catalysts 1–3.

target_reaction: 4-bromoanisole + phenylboronic acid -> 4-methoxybiphenyl [底物来自p.4 Table 1标题/脚注a;产物名称依据p.3 Scheme 1中R=OCH3的结构作名称对应,属结构到名称的映射推断,不是entry 7逐字列出的产物名]

base.name: sodium tert-butoxide (NaOtBu)
base.source: 原文直接信息:PDF p.4 Table 1脚注a写sodium tert-butoxide (0.5 mmol)(PDF跨行排字tert-/butoxide);§2.3 p.3仅写specified base (0.5 mmol)。NaOtBu为规范缩写,非脚注a原始拼写。

result.metric: Author-reported Yield (%) measured by GC with hexadecane internal standard; ambiguity retained: footnote c also says 'for total conversion'. Not unconditionally normalized to target-product GC yield or substrate total conversion; not an isolated yield value.
result.source: 【表头,原文直接信息】PDF p.4 Table 1: Yield (%)带a,b,c脚注;entry 7为91.9上标a,未写Conversion (%)。【脚注c,原文完整句】'Reaction yield (%) for total conversion determined from the internal standard yield, at the specified reaction time, based on gas chromatography (GC), using hexadecane as internal standard.'【正文§2.3,p.3】'GC-calculated yields were based on the amount of 4-bromoanisole or 4-bromobenzonitrile employed.'【紧邻正文,p.4 Table 1后】作者并列使用'yields (93–95%) and conversions (73–99%)'(指催化剂3,不能套给entry 7),另写'An increase in the product yield with temperature'。【解释,非逐字结论】表头及正文倾向于产物收率解释,但脚注c混合yield与total conversion措辞且缺少唯一判别计算式;本次保留歧义,不确定地归入任一类别。

solvent.name: methanol
solvent.source: 原文直接信息:PDF p.4 Table 1脚注a和§2.3 p.3均为methanol (1 mL)。

catalyst.name: Pd-bpydc-Ce (2)
catalyst.source: PDF p.4 Table 1的entries 5–8共享Pd-bpydc-Ce (2)合并单元格;entry 7结果上标a对应脚注a 'catalyst (0.5 mol %)';为版式/脚注直接关联读取,不是机制推断。§2.3 p.3只给0.2–0.5 mol%通用范围。所查范围未明确按Pd原子还是复合催化剂实体计量,不自行换算或给出质量。

substrate.name: 4-bromoanisole
substrate.source: 原文直接信息:PDF p.4 Table 1标题、脚注a;§2.3 p.3列4-bromoanisole (0.5 mmol) or 4-bromobenzonitrile (0.5 mmol),其中Table 1指定前者。

conditions.source: 温度和时间为原文直接信息:PDF p.4 Table 1 entry 7,T (°C)=60、Time (h)=4。气氛原文见§2.3 p.3 'stirred at 30 °C or 60 °C in air';Table 1未单列气氛。将in air应用于entry 7为通法关联,不是该条独立记录。
conditions.atmosphere: air (general procedure linkage; not separately specified in entry 7)

coupling_partner.name: phenylboronic acid
coupling_partner.source: 原文直接信息:PDF p.4 Table 1标题/脚注a;§2.3 p.3,phenylboronic acid (0.6 mmol)。

quantitative_method.basis: §2.3 p.3原文:GC-calculated yields were based on the amount of 4-bromoanisole or 4-bromobenzonitrile employed;Table 1限定为4-bromoanisole投料量基准。不因此消除脚注c的yield/total conversion歧义。
quantitative_method.method: Gas chromatography (GC) with internal standard; progress monitoring by GC-MS per §2.3; exact yield-vs-conversion definition unresolved
quantitative_method.source: 原文直接信息:PDF p.4 Table 1脚注c说明GC和hexadecane内标;§2.3 p.3说明定期取样GC-MS及GC-calculated yields的投料基准;§2.3 p.4续文说明产品鉴定。所查段落没有列出entry 7响应因子、校准曲线或完整计算式。
quantitative_method.instrument: Entry 7的定量仪器型号在本次限定段落中未明确;§2.3 p.4只说明all coupling products were identified by Agilent 7890A-5975C GC-MS and 1H NMR,不能把鉴定仪器擅自指定为该条定量仪器。

notes_and_discrepancies: 本次纠正旧记录将91.9%无条件归为目标产物GC收率的过强结论。可靠记录为Yield (%)栏的91.9%,GC/hexadecane内标;脚注c的for total conversion必须保留。表头/正文较支持产物收率解释只是解释,不能冒充原文唯一界定。
不能把91.9%确认成底物总转化率;该条也没有单独报告可确认的分离收率。§2.3描述分离纯化不等于Table 1给的是分离收率。
Table 1表头Yield (%)及上标a,b,c;entry 7为91.9上标a。脚注b给0.2 mol%,不适用于entry 7;脚注c是结果方法说明。
气氛in air来自§2.3 p.3,不是Table 1逐条所列;应用于entry 7标记为通法关联。
Catalyst name与entry 7的归属按p.4合并单元格核验,不因PMC文本表格列错位而将其视为未知。0.5 mol%按作者文字保留,不换算Pd原子mol%。
本次所查正文中的93–95% yields和73–99% conversions指催化剂3,不能给entry 7的Ce催化剂补填转化率。
原结构的target_reaction保留,但产物规范名称为p.3 Scheme 1结构对应的命名推断;底物组合、投料和条件有Table 1及§2.3直接文字依据。
本次只核验上述文献段落,没有诊断模拟实验,没有将文献数值与模拟分离收率进行比较。
